visual_observations: Seven columns, empty board, human/bot discs and winning line are visible in the playing screenshots.
Landscape screenshots show the original Lumo companion beside the board. The portrait playing captures frame the board without showing that companion.
The finished-round menu is intentionally scrollable on short landscape viewports; lower menu actions are outside the initial viewport.
scope: Root visual inspection of actual desktop-rendered CI images; not a physical Android performance measurement, user/human receipt or all-app visual acceptance.
